in_scope.instructions:
As part of our ongoing product revamp, we have decided to remove the CRM Suite of products from the HackerOne program scope.

Out of Scope:
CRM Suite of Products – https://yourdomain.myfreshworks.com/crm/*

Please note that the main domain "https://yourdomain.myfreshworks.com" remains in scope. Only the /crm/* path has been removed from the HackerOne program scope.

We request that researchers ensure all security testing is limited to the assets and endpoints currently listed as “In-Scope” in the HackerOne program description.
